cross_verification.note: Comoros issues most visas on arrival at the airport/seaport rather than through a public online e-visa system, and no functioning official Union of the Comoros government domain with visa photo specifications could be located during this research pass (egouv.km refused connections; ambassade-comores.com reset the connection). The only reachable official source, the Permanent Mission of the Union of the Comoros to the UN (un.int/comoros), covers the visa fee/process but states no photo size, background, or composition rules. Third-party aggregator sites conflict with each other on background colour (plain white vs. light blue/grey per differing sources), which is itself a reason to leave these fields unverified rather than adopt any single aggregator's figure, per the truthfulness gate.
